recap.narration_text: Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: increases. after. after. Greater crash speed increases the potential for severe injury. Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: protect. one. sensors. Adjust the head restraint before driving to help protect against whiplash. Active safety technology assists in preventing a collision; passive protection helps occupants during one. Reverse sensors and backup cameras assist in detecting obstacles behind the vehicle.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: seat. head restraint. bent. Adjust the driver’s seat before the vehicle begins moving. Position the head restraint so it supports the head when leaning back. Keep the elbows slightly bent while holding the wheel and the knees slightly bent when operating a pedal.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: behind. slippery. more. On a wet road, slow down and increase the gap behind the vehicle ahead.
